# Tratum

> Tratum is an institution-first financial infrastructure platform developed by YHWH Vision Ventures Technologies Ltd. It combines hardware endpoints, embedded banking software, security, communications, synchronization, APIs and settlement infrastructure for resilient digital financial services.
